12.description: The Planning Commission defeated a recommendation to deny rezoning 1401 11th Street West from R2 to RM2, allowing a proposed six-unit residential development.

chips.text: Residents of the Holiday Park neighborhood are affected by the proposed six-unit development.
City administration recommended denying the rezoning
Holiday Park Community Association and 69 residents opposed the six-unit development.
Councillor Derek opposed denial, citing inflexible policy for larger corner sites and housing needs.

11.description: The item rezones vacant land at 902-938 3rd Avenue North from institutional to residential, allowing for medium-density housing and supporting infill development.

chips.text: People walking, cycling, and driving on 3rd Avenue will see safety improvements.
Saskatoon Land will report to the Standing Policy Committee on Finance on development plans.

9.description: Chair Harley reported on decisions from the March 25, 2026, Public Hearing, including approvals for a commercial school and sign regulations, and the denial of an OCP amendment.

chips.text: Council questioned how rezoning applications are evaluated and how OCP supersedes local area plans.
